My genuinely new answer to the thread goes right here in this line.

Songbo

Address prefixes are orderable as a property of the objects so containment
is mechanical.
Communities are the opposite by design with semantics that stay strictly
bilateral throughout.
Both are useful and the protocol does not pretend the second case is
the first.
